newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 10.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Review your prices lower, government tells distributors of petroleum products. Consumers have complained of high prices since government liberalisation of the petroleum marketing sector came into effect on September 22.
- French hotel group Accor wants to consolidate its holdings in Ivory Coast, operations director Daniel Lin says during visit to Abidjan.
- Petrol price hikes: a victory for distributors
- Burkina Faso junior officer whose followers were arrested last Sunday for alleged acts of indiscipline sheltered in Abidjan; coup rumours in Burkina.
